evals.prompt: Set up fingerprint login on my Ubuntu laptop. fprintd is not installed yet.
evals.expected_output: Ledger that includes PAM fprintd timeout and max-tries, password fallback, boot persistence; failure path tested. Not-done ledger lists omissions (e.g. sudo/passwordless login, fingerprint-only, extra fingers) each with why-not.

evals.prompt: Harden SSH on my home server so only I can log in with a key.
evals.expected_output: Ledger covering PasswordAuthentication, PermitRootLogin, AllowUsers, MaxAuthTries, LoginGraceTime, ClientAliveInterval, port, lockout recovery path; asks before disabling password auth. Not-done ledger lists omissions (e.g. changing port, fail2ban, 2FA) with why-not.

evals.prompt: Add a systemd service that runs my Go binary at boot and restarts it if it crashes.
evals.expected_output: Ledger covering Restart policy, RestartSec, StartLimitBurst/Interval, User, WorkingDirectory, After/Wants ordering, log destination, resource limits. Not-done ledger lists omissions (e.g. hardening directives, watchdog) with why-not.

evals.prompt: Rename the variable foo to bar in this one file.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT run the full process (trivial, reversible). At most Lite or no ledger.
